svg.title: Tools and engineering practice
svg.desc: Frontend and design: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Figma, TanStack, GraphQL, MUI and styled-components. Backend and delivery: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker, Azure, Google Cloud and Git. AI with intent: Spec, Agents, Review and Verify form a clockwise loop around human judgment. Spec-driven, human-reviewed work. A small marker follows the loop unless reduced motion is preferred.
